s.n: Grinch green spinach and herb dip
s.note: the Grinch himself, green and grumpy
s.how: Blanch 100g baby spinach in boiling water for 20 seconds, drain and squeeze dry. Blitz with 1 avocado, 200g Greek yoghurt, a handful each of basil and parsley, 1 small garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt until smooth and very green. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp. Serve the dip with the pita chips and cucumber sticks.

s.note: the Grinch's cave up on Mount Crumpit
s.how: Cut a 500g cob loaf in a criss-cross pattern every 2cm, without cutting through the base. Melt 80g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped chives. Spoon the butter into the cuts, then stuff with 200g grated mozzarella and 40g grated parmesan. Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 minutes more until golden and melted. Pull apart at the table.

m.n: Whoville roast beast with crispy potatoes
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg beef sirloin roast with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, oil and salt. Parboil 1.2kg quartered potatoes for 8 minutes, drain, rough up and toss in 3 tbsp duck fat. Roast the potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes and the beef for 50 minutes for medium rare, adding 4 carrots tossed in honey for the last 35. Rest the beef 15 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices with 400ml beef stock to make gravy.

w.note: the Who pudding the whole town sits down to
w.how: Steam an 800g Christmas pudding in its basin over simmering water for 1 hour, or follow the packet. Warm 500ml milk and 100ml cream. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 60g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick. Add 1 tsp vanilla. Turn out the pudding, cut into wedges and serve with custard, ice cream and a few Christmas sprinkles.

d.note: Max running the Grinch's morning brew
d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk with 1 tbsp caster sugar until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate and 1 tbsp cocoa until melted and frothy, or blitz with a stick blender for extra froth. Pour into 4 mugs. Whip 150ml thickened cream with 1 tsp icing sugar, spoon on top and finish with green sprinkles and a little cocoa dusted over.
